products.short: Deep, savory heat. Our original family recipe.
intro: Our Laos Chile Paste is a bold, savory blend crafted with sun dried organic New Mexican red chile, garlic, and traditional Lao spices. It comes from a cherished family recipe. Prepared in small batches, it’s delicious as a marinade, dip, or cooking base.
Bring the deep, savory flavor of Lao cooking to your favorite dishes. No preservatives or artificial ingredients, just rich, handcrafted flavor.
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, broccoli)
instructions: In a hot skillet, add sesame oil and stir-fry vegetables until tender.
Add Laos Chile Paste and soy sauce; stir well.
Toss in cooked noodles and mix until evenly coated.
Garnish with cilantro and serve hot.

products.short: Sweet, tangy, and spicy. A little goes a long way.
intro: Our Vegan Tamarind Chile Sauce is sweet, tangy, and spicy. It blends tamarind, chiles, and aromatic spices for a rich, complex flavor in every bite. Made with all-natural, plant-based ingredients, it’s perfect as a dip, glaze, or finishing drizzle.
It pairs beautifully with grilled vegetables, tofu, noodles, and is especially delicious with chicken alternatives or as a dipping sauce for spring rolls and appetizers.
No artificial ingredients. No preservatives. Just vibrant, vegan flavor inspired by traditional Laos cooking.
ingredients: 1 package vegan chicken strips or chunks
instructions: Assemble skewers with vegan chicken and vegetables.
Brush with Vegan Tamarind Chile Sauce.
Grill or bake at 400°F for 15–20 minutes, brushing again halfway.
Serve with rice or salad and extra sauce for dipping.

products.short: Savory with a hint of mango sweetness and a chile kick.
intro: Our Vegan Mango Salsa is a tropical twist on traditional heat, with sweet, juicy mangoes blended with chiles, herbs, and spices for a bright, balanced flavor with just the right amount of kick. Made with all-natural, plant-based ingredients, it brings a little sunshine to your table.
Perfect as a dip, taco topping, or side for grilled dishes, this salsa brings a refreshing burst of flavor to any meal.
No preservatives. No artificial ingredients. Just fresh, bold, and vibrant taste in every bite.
instructions: Warm tortillas and layer with black beans, avocado, and cabbage.
Top with a generous spoonful of Vegan Mango Salsa.
Serve with lime wedges and enjoy!

products.short: All the bold flavor. Made entirely from plants.
intro: Our Vegan Chile Paste brings bold, savory flavor without fish sauce. Crafted with sun dried organic New Mexican red chile, garlic, herbs, and spices, this plant-based version is rich in flavor and 100% vegan.
Made in small batches, it’s delicious as a marinade, stir-fry base, or dipping sauce. Add deep, satisfying spice to traditional dishes or your own creations.
No fish sauce. No preservatives or artificial ingredients. Just handcrafted heat.
ingredients: 1 cup steamed greens (bok choy, spinach, or kale)
instructions: Pan-fry tofu in olive oil until golden.
Add Vegan Chile Paste and cook for 2–3 minutes to coat.
Serve tofu over rice with steamed greens.
Drizzle with lime juice before serving.

story: Our journey began in the heart of our family kitchen, where Grandma lovingly created her signature Laos Chile Paste. Its vibrant, savory blend of spices added the perfect kick to many traditional Laos dishes. What started as a staple at family gatherings quickly became a favorite among friends, neighbors, and eventually, a wider community of food lovers who craved something truly original.
Inspired by Grandma’s passion and recipes passed down through generations, we decided to turn her beloved chile paste into the foundation of a business. With that, Kinna's Kitchen was born.

Since launching with our first product, the Laos Chile Paste, we’ve continued to grow while staying guided by our family roots and commitment to quality. Every jar we make carries the bold flavors and cultural richness of Laos, crafted with care and tradition in every batch.
At Kinna’s Kitchen, we believe food is more than just nourishment. It connects us to heritage, family, and the joy of sharing something truly special.
Welcome to our kitchen. We're glad you're here.
